Why Boost Blends

Fuel your build without overpaying.

Boost Blends was created to bring the automotive community a better, more cost-effective way to fuel their builds.

Our E85 is blended using E98 ethanol and premium 92-octane gasoline with consistency in mind. Whether you're fueling a street car, weekend build, race setup, or buying E98 for your own blend, we keep the process straightforward and local.
